proposal: Make Serie A (ita.1) + Bundesliga (ger.1) WHOLESALE-fetched by the static ESPN football fetcher, mirroring the already-shipped La Liga (esp.1) pattern. Add both league codes to scripts/config/sports-config.js football leagues and to the client mirror SS_FOOTBALL_LEAGUES in docs/js/shared-constants.js (pinned to config by tests/live-leagues.test.js). Until now these two catalog-covered top-5 leagues had no static fetcher and were hand-boarded round-for-round as source:ai-research, costing a research pass every matchweek and leaving them structurally research-dependent.
evidence: catalog.json notes (self-documented): 'Serie A/Bundesliga åpningsrundene boardet som ai-research (tidligere kun La Liga wholesale via ESPN esp.1) — flagget self-repair å legge ita.1/ger.1 i ESPN-fetcheren for varig wholesale-dekning.' The fix was flagged in the catalog itself and never done.

coverage-audit.json (2026-09-28T09:35:00Z) sourceIssues[medium]: 'Serie A / Bundesliga 10.–11. okt er IKKE boardet … avhenger av research (ita.1/ger.1 mangler i ESPN-fetcheren). … legg ita.1 (Serie A) + ger.1 (Bundesliga) i ESPN-fetcheren for varig wholesale-dekning, slik La Liga (esp.1) allerede har.'
research-log.json (2026-09-28T05:30:00Z) carries the same standing flag run-after-run: 'ita.1/ger.1 mangler i ESPN-fetcher (Serie A/Bundesliga research-avhengige)'.

scout-log.json: a stale/false 'Bundesliga 2026/27 imminent Sep 30' contract-breach signal recurred as pre-existing noise from Sep 24 through Sep 28 (~4 days). Wholesale-fetching Bundesliga lets its resumption round (10–11 Oct) board mechanically instead of via a hand-maintained tracked.json date.

catalog.json tier2.tournaments already lists Serie A + Bundesliga as covered; scripts/seed-registry/espn.js FOOTBALL_LEAGUES already seeds their clubs ('the leagues the research agent demonstrably fills (ita.1, ger.1 — measured)'). Only the fetcher config lagged.
npm test: 88 files / 1541 tests pass, incl. tests/live-leagues.test.js which derives its expected league set from sports-config and now validates the ita.1/ger.1 addition + its client mirror.
expectedEffect: Serie A + Bundesliga fixtures land on the board from the static pipeline (free, hourly) the way La Liga already does, instead of being hand-boarded by the research agent each matchweek. Fewer research passes spent re-boarding two whole leagues; the recurring coverage-audit medium sourceIssue and the recurring Bundesliga false-imminent scout noise both resolve at the root. The football fetcher's Norwegian-first ordering + focused mode (unchanged) keeps domestic + marquee clubs ahead of the maxEvents(30) cut, exactly as it does today for esp.1.
howWeKnow: coverage-audit.json stops emitting the ita.1/ger.1 medium sourceIssue; football.json contains ita.1/ger.1 fixtures; Serie A/Bundesliga rounds board as source:espn (not ai-research); scout-log stops carrying the Bundesliga imminent contract-breach.
notes: Smallest change that delivers the flagged fix: two league codes + the enforced client mirror; no maxEvents change (the existing Norwegian-first + focused ordering already protects domestic/marquee under the cut, same as esp.1 today).

iOS live-league parity (LiveLeague.forEvent) is left as an owner follow-up — adding ita.1/ger.1 there is optional (live scoring), touches the protected/separate ios track, and does not affect web board coverage.
